Can you share: 1) the redacted PT report (executive + findings) and 2) a CSV export of any open findings/remediation status?

Can you confirm what you can provide and the expected timeline? We're working to hit an internal compliance deadline next Wednesday.

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report (hosted API) and delivery mechanism

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. We can share a redacted penetration test report that covers our Hosted API (production clusters in us-west) and a findings CSV with remediation statuses. High level: the PT was performed against our production-serving fleet and associated control plane; third-party managed infra (cloud provider host-level services) is scoped where applicable and is noted in the report. PII is redacted by default; we can produce a separate raw findings CSV that lists the finding id, severity, status, first reported date, and assigned owner.

Delivery options (pick one):
- Secure SFTP (short-lived account, IP allowlist) — we create credentials and rotate after download.
- Encrypted presigned S3 link (48h expiry) + password over separate channel (SMS/phone/secure chat). Files are encrypted server-side (AES-256) and then put behind the presigned URL.
- Ephemeral Evidence Portal — authenticated access for your security contact with audit logs and time-limited viewing (recommended for longer review teams).

Our usual process: security ops (I will loop them in) prepares a redaction review (24–48 hrs), we generate one-time access (48 hr window), and we include a findings CSV. Standard retention we can support is 30 days; we can discuss shorter/longer if needed.

Attached is a short checklist with our evidence-transfer options and the information we need from you to proceed. If you confirm presigned S3 + password by EOD, I will: 1) create an encrypted artifact, 2) get Marissa (security ops) to produce the URL and password, and 3) share the CSV of open findings.

If you prefer SFTP, let me know the allowed IPs and we will provision.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Security & GTM
Redwood Inference
